headings: President Daniel Francisco Chapo of the Republic of Mozambique visited Wasion with his delegation
paragraphs: Recently, His Excellency President Daniel Francisco Chapo of the Republic of Mozambique led a delegation to visit Wasion Holdings. This visit marks the first overseas trip of the newly elected president, with Hunan, China chosen as the first stop. Wasion Holdings was a key enterprise on his agenda, highlighting the strong traditional friendship between China and Mozambique and the shared commitment to deepening pragmatic cooperation in the energy sector. Senior representatives from Wasion Holdings and Willfar Information accompanied the visit. Both sides held in-depth discussions on Mozambique’s 2030 national development vision, energy infrastructure development, and China-Africa cooperation in energy digitalization, reaching important consensus.

As a leading enterprise in China’s energy Internet of Things sector, Wasion Holdings operates both domestic and overseas listed platforms and has built a complete industrial chain covering energy metering, digital grids, renewable energy, and international business. With operations spanning more than 70 countries and regions, Wasion possesses full-chain service capabilities—from core chips and smart terminals to system solutions and localized operations—serving as a key representative of China’s energy and power technologies going global and providing reliable, proven solutions for the global energy transition.

Mozambique’s 2030 national development vision prioritizes the improvement of power infrastructure, smart grid upgrades, and clean energy development, aiming to enhance power supply reliability and energy governance. These priorities align closely with Wasion’s technological strengths and industrial presence. Through integrated solutions including smart metering, intelligent distribution networks, renewable energy integration, and energy IoT management, Wasion is well-positioned to meet Mozambique’s energy development needs. The company can help improve grid reliability, reduce operational losses, and promote green, low-carbon development, providing strong support for Mozambique in achieving its 2030 goals and setting a benchmark for China-Africa cooperation in energy and public welfare.

During the visit, representatives from Wasion Holdings and Willfar Information extended a warm welcome to the president and his delegation. China and Mozambique share a long-standing friendship and a solid foundation for cooperation. Mozambique has tremendous development potential, particularly in energy infrastructure and digital transformation. With extensive project experience and localized operations across Africa, Wasion can provide one-stop services covering technology, equipment, engineering, operations and maintenance, and talent development. Wasion is committed to leveraging its full industrial chain to actively participate in Mozambique’s energy infrastructure development, promote technology and industrial localization, and support the country in enhancing its independent development capacity, contributing to the deepening of China-Mozambique relations and the high-quality development of the Belt and Road Initiative.

During the exhibition hall tour, the delegation listened attentively to presentations on Wasion’s core technologies, product portfolio, and global application cases, gaining detailed insights into intelligent sensing devices, energy IoT platforms, and comprehensive smart grid solutions. From China’s power grid modernization practices to global energy cooperation achievements, Wasion’s advanced technologies, integrated industrial capabilities, and solid project experience left a strong impression on the delegation.

At the conclusion of the visit, President Chapo delivered a summary speech on site. He remarked: “Today’s visit to Wasion has been truly impressive. The company’s achievements in the energy sector are remarkable. We understand that Wasion has already established a presence in Africa and has carried out practical cooperation with local power utilities in countries such as Mozambique and South Africa. We sincerely hope that Wasion will invest and establish a manufacturing base in Mozambique to support the realization of our 2030 development vision. We will actively advance the necessary steps and strive to see a Wasion production facility established in Mozambique at an early date. Thank you very much!”

The president’s remarks fully recognized Wasion’s technological strengths and industrial advantages, expressing a strong willingness to advance cooperation. Following the speech, representatives from Wasion Holdings presented the president and his delegation with self-developed core sensing chips and commemorative gifts symbolizing China-Africa friendship. The visit concluded successfully, marking a new chapter in China-Mozambique cooperation in energy digitalization and injecting fresh momentum into China-Africa pragmatic cooperation.

headings: The Wasion International's 2025 Annual Summary and Commendation Conference was successfully held
paragraphs: On the afternoon of February 10, Wasion International successfully held its 2025 Annual Summary and Commendation Meeting under the theme "Steady progress, Innovative development." Mr. Ji Wei, Chairman of the Board of Wasion Holdings, along with relevant leaders, the Wasion International management team, 2025 award-winning teams and individuals, and over 300 employee representatives, attended the event.

The meeting commenced with a retrospective video of Wasion International's 2025 milestones, revisiting the memorable moments of the company’s international business expansion and global development over the past year.

Mr. Ji Wei, Chairman of the Board of Wasion Holdings, delivered key instructions:"2026 is the 'Inaugural Year' of Wasion’s '6th Five-Year' Strategy and a 'Crucial Year' for our overall development. Wasion must foresee risks within stability, identify challenges within prosperity, and seize the initiative from opportunities. We must remain anchored to Internationalization, Digitalization, and Decarbonization. By leveraging the synergy between Power and Computing Power, we aim to become a leading Chinese expert in energy metering and energy efficiency management."

During the meeting, Mr. Tian Zhongping, Chairman of Wasion International, delivered the 2025 Management Work Summary Report. He stated: "This year, Wasion International closely followed the global wave of smart grid development and the international consensus on green, low-carbon, and energy digitalization, integrating sustainable development into every stage of our business. We deepened our presence in mature markets while making bold breakthroughs in emerging markets, planning our layout with a truly global mindset. Our international R&D has fully aligned with global standards, achieving a leap from following technology to walking side-by-side with industry leaders, significantly boosting product competitiveness. Operationally, we implemented localized delivery and strengthened our overseas talent pool, allowing more international talent to take root in Wasion and empower our growth."

Mr. Lv Xinwei, President of Wasion International, announced the commendation decisions. The ceremony presented 18 categories of awards, including the Annual Outstanding Contribution Team, Annual Innovative Business Development Team, Market & Sales Innovation Team, Technology & Product Innovation Team, Operations & Service Innovation Team, Management & Mechanism Innovation Team, Excellent Team, Sales Star, Distinguished Designer, Service Star, Quality Pace-setter, Excellent Executive, and Excellent Employee. In total, 128 outstanding individuals and 26 advanced teams were honored.

In 2025, the role models of Wasion wrote chapters of excellence through extraordinary commitment. From the dawn of the Americas to the dusk of Africa, and from the sunrise in Europe to the evening lights of Asia, their footsteps of progress span every time zone. From R&D laboratories to project frontlines, and from management communication to logistics, professional brilliance shines in every role. They achieved sales breakthroughs amidst challenges and ensured high-standard delivery under pressure.
